fatal_failures: production or authored tests do not compile and run from a clean offline copy
the caller-visible Project or Parse entry point is absent
the report boundary does not use genuine generated CDM 7.0.0 Price, NonNegativeQuantity, and TradeIdentifier values
a rate crosses the seam without the 100x basis conversion in either direction
an absent optional fact is emitted as a zero-valued or empty element
scientific notation, exponent forms, or digit-limit truncation reach emitted XML
round-trip idempotence fails on any fixture report
licensed ISDA DRR rule content or a DRR runtime is embedded, downloaded, or executed

criteria.description: Convert the CDM decimal-fraction rate to an ISO percentage and back exactly, preserving zero and sign.
checks: 0.0525 projects as 5.25 and parses back to exactly 0.0525.
A zero rate survives the round trip as an explicit 0 element, not an absence.
-0.005 projects as -0.5 with its sign intact and parses back to -0.005.
The conversion is exact decimal arithmetic; no binary-float artefacts appear at any scale.

criteria.description: Distinguish absent, zero, and empty for optional facts in both directions.
checks: An optional CDM fact with no value produces no element at all.
No absent fact is ever emitted as a zero-valued element.
No empty element is ever emitted, and Parse rejects an empty element as a schema violation rather than reading it as zero or absent.
A genuine zero value remains distinguishable from absence after the round trip.

criteria.description: Emit schema-canonical decimals and fail closed on the declared digit limits.
checks: A value held as 1.23E7 serialises as 12300000 with no exponent regardless of internal representation.
A value exceeding eighteen total digits or five fraction digits fails Project before any output is produced.
No silent truncation or rounding occurs on the way to XML.
Canonical serialisation is stable: the same value always produces the same lexical form.

criteria.description: Prove Project after Parse after Project is byte-identical across a fixture set.
checks: Project(Parse(Project(r))) is byte-identical to Project(r) for every fixture report.
The fixture set holds at least four distinct reports exercising every mapped enum value and an absent optional fact.
All timestamps normalise to UTC with the Z designator, and a +00:00 input does not survive as +00:00.
Every CDM-enum-to-ISO mapping is bijective and a value without a code fails visibly.

criteria.description: Use genuine validated generated CDM types at the report boundary.
checks: The rate is a generated Price with priceType InterestRate and a currency unit satisfying CurrencyUnitForInterestRate.
The notional is a generated NonNegativeQuantity with a currency unit; the UTI is a TradeIdentifier with identifierType UniqueTransactionIdentifier.
Populated relied-on CDM nodes pass their generated validation in at least one test.
Values are held as exact decimals end to end; no double conversion sits inside the seam.

criteria.description: Fail closed with no partial output and no silently ignored input.
checks: A failed projection emits no partial XML.
Parse rejects unknown elements and unknown enum codes rather than skipping them.
Failure messages name the offending fact and limit.
No error path returns a default or zeroed CDM value.

criteria.description: Tests include close negative controls that would catch the classic breaks.
checks: A test distinguishes the two percentage-family PriceExpressionEnum values across the round trip.
A test proves the +00:00 offset form is normalised or rejected, not preserved.
At least one mutation-style check (for example dropping the basis conversion) demonstrably fails the suite.
Negative tests assert the specific refusal, not merely any exception.
